what: Eight play pieces (chess pawn, rook, king, queen, dice, card) float in 3D over the stage — four each on two canvases, one behind the art and one in front (30° field of view · camera z 20), with toon-style three-step shading and brown outlines. On attach each piece flies in late by 1~1.6s over 2.6s expo.out from off screen (back layer from inner depth −5, front layer from 1.8x outside at depth +9) with one or two spins and lands, then bobs up and down as if breathing (.7 speed · .07 amplitude) and turns slowly at drift speed. The camera follows the cursor from anywhere on screen with exponential damping 2.8, shifting 1.4 horizontally · −.8 vertically, which gives parallax between layers. Hovering a piece grows it 1.08x and tilts it, and pressing makes a .32s squash-bounce and rolls it at 15 (dice 19) rad/s, then when slowed by damping 2.2 it settles on the nearest face (dice 90° · others one full turn). Scrolling the stage down moves the front layer up in proportion to depth and the back layer slightly down

options.look: board — a group on a chessboard (big pawn in the middle, rook behind, king, dice in front, five cards). Default is eight around the hero
options.delay: Seconds to delay the whole entrance — to match loader and transition curtains, default 0
options.[data-fx-part=back]·[data-fx-part=front]: Back layer · front layer canvas slots (two slots covering the panel fully) — art goes in between
options.--fx-ivory · --fx-gold · --fx-line: Horse body color · gold color · border color (default --kf-ink · --kf-accent · gold darkened toward the background)

from.where: index.html .tt-hero__stage (eight) · about.html .tt-ahero__stage (look: board). Original mountHeroPieces: table of slot at · depth · size · tilt · drift, camera fov 30 · z 20 · damping 2.8 · (1.4, −.8), entrance 2.6 expo.out then 1+.09i · front 1.15+.07i, float sin(.7t) × .07, press 15/19 rad/s · damping 2.2 · fit 6, hover raise 1.08x

note: Instead of the original model file, our own horse is built from lathe shapes and boxes — only the silhouette proportions match. Drawing pauses when off-screen. With reduced motion it stands in place at once and ignores cursor and press.
